This additional work might be helpful, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.11754
Full disclaimer, I'm one of the authors

We haven't tried on the competition dataset yet.
The inference code and pre-trained model are available at https://github.com/royerlab/hoct
The training code isn't available yet because it's under peer review.
The tracking results depend on the quality of the segmentation mask.

I suggest comparing CPU vs GPU inference, depending on the number of cells, the first might be faster.
